renameTabDialog.title: Rename tab
renameTabDialog.hint: Leave it empty to go back to using the conversation title.

pairing.title: Pairing expired
pairing.expiredDetail: This one-time link has expired or was already used. Rescan the QR code from the host to link this device again.
pairing.lockedDetail: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then rescan a fresh QR code from the host.
pairing.networkDetail: Couldn’t reach the host to complete pairing. Check your connection, then rescan the QR code from the host.

forbidden.title: 403 · Forbidden
forbidden.detail: This device isn’t paired. Open the Remote Control panel on the host and scan its QR code to connect.

effortSlider.tooltip: Click or drag to set effort level
effortSlider.tooltipUltracode: Click or drag to set effort level (top step = ultracode)

mcpModal.title: MCP servers
mcpModal.editReplaceSingle: Editing replaces a single server — paste exactly one server config.

form.nameHint: Optional — only used when your JSON has no “mcpServers” wrapper
form.configHint: Paste an mcpServers config or a single server config

marketplace.searchPrompt: Search the official MCP registry to find and install servers.

tunnelModal.title: Remote Tunnel
tunnelModal.keepAwake: Keep awake while tunnel is active
tunnelModal.pairingHint: Scan to link a device. The QR carries a one-time code that expires shortly — regenerate it if it stops working.

tunnelStatusNotice.installConsent: cloudflared isn’t installed. Install it now and enable the tunnel? This downloads cloudflared (about 3 minutes the first time).
tunnelStatusNotice.notInstalledWarning: cloudflared isn’t installed yet. Turning the tunnel on will ask to download it (about 3 minutes the first time).

cloudflaredMissing.title: Couldn’t install cloudflared
cloudflaredMissing.detail: The tunnel needs cloudflared, and it couldn’t be installed automatically. Install it manually, then try again.

timeout.title: Tunnel connection timed out
timeout.detail: Couldn’t reach the Cloudflare tunnel server in time. Check your network or firewall — some regions restrict access to Cloudflare.

exited.title: cloudflared stopped unexpectedly
exited.detail: The tunnel process exited before it was ready. Please try again.

unknown.title: Couldn’t start the tunnel
unknown.detail: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

sponsorGated.message: This is a feature for our sponsors
